comments.author: ohyes
comments.why: Shows Xenakis score as example of evolving, radically different musical notation.
comments.text: Western musical notation has been continuously evolving. It is far from being 'largely unchanged for hundreds of years'. For example, look at the notation for this piece by Iannis Xenakis. (Shows the sheet music in the video). [VIDEO] Compare to this gregorian chant: [LINK] Or to this piece by his teacher oliver messiaen [LINK] There are some important things that are the same between the chant and the piece by Messian, but the notations are very very different, and have accumulated some really important stuff over the years. Saying that musical notation has been largely unchanged for hundreds of years is kind of like saying that English has remained largely unchanged for hundreds of years.... in that it is incorrect.
